depthSignals.allocationEntropy: mean theater-allocation entropy must not fall more than 0.05 below the same-cell baseline
depthSignals.counterplay: the 32-cell block must contain at least two behind-to-ahead Pulse reversals; the observed 160-cell shared-stock baseline contains zero
depthSignals.firstPulse: first-Pulse conversion must be below 70% and no worse than the same-cell baseline
depthSignals.openingDiversity: coarse opening archetype diversity at ticks 25, 75, and 125 must not contract relative to the same-cell baseline
depthSignals.theaterUse: each Well supplies at least 20% of deliveries and delivery-source normalized entropy remains at least 0.95

fairness.mirrors: side-locked mirrored splits must not exceed the same-cell baseline and entrant sweeps remain disclosed
fairness.sideShare: each side receives 40-60% of decided wins in the 32-cell block; exact 180-degree map symmetry is necessary but not sufficient

hardGates.cohortEligibility: every retained side passes felt-degeneracy v3
hardGates.determinism: every retained replay verifies byte-identically and the six historical golden hashes remain unchanged

pacingAndContact.contest: contested-pickup proxy share remains at least 80% of the same-cell baseline
pacingAndContact.duration: median end tick may grow at most 15% over the same-cell baseline and p90 remains below tick 560

productLimits: passing numeric gates is not a fun claim
the shared stock algorithm establishes same-policy geometry causality, not a rules-native product verdict
the recommended arm still needs a twelve-match outcome-blind owner watch and independent/adversarial doctrine evidence

arms.isolation: vertical theater separation; equal Well-to-reactor shortest paths; map-native y-remapped evaluation sheets; rules and cadence unchanged
chiral north/south cover exchange with exact 180-degree fairness; dimensions, open count, Well positions, authored coordinates, rules, and cadence unchanged

classification: substantial ranked-map geometry study in fast-iteration mode; provisional until native and owner-view evidence
evidenceStages: same-cell in-process screen for gross outcome/pacing rejection with registered WASM parity sample
all 32 registered cells for every retained arm under canonical WASM, exact verification, broadcast, and v3 scorecard
four-lineage independent native round-robin on the recommended arm, labelled map-compatibility evidence unless doctrines are adapted
targeted adversarial counter-web and passive/convoy sentinels
fresh twelve-match outcome-blind gallery from the recommended arm

hypotheses.counterflow: fair rotational asymmetry can make route reading, lane ownership, and counters more varied without granting either spawn a globally superior map; it may instead create one dominant route or expose executor-side bias
hypotheses.larger: greater distance between north, centre, and south can make allocation and rotations consequential and reduce centre-only damage and first-Pulse lock; it may instead create empty travel, lower contest, and longer repetitive matches
hypotheses.null: neither geometry change improves meaningful counterplay enough to justify displacing the compact symmetric baseline

knownBaselineReadBeforeRegistration.warning: these opened baseline aggregates motivated the study; no candidate outcomes existed at registration

pairBlock.selection: registered style-spanning pairs, not selected from candidate outcomes

prohibitions: no class, composition, cadence, combat, or objective-economy change in these arms
no threshold movement after candidate outcomes are opened
no recommendation by aggregate win rate alone
no fun claim without human replay review
